recognize_zh: 單顆淋巴球核呈卵圓形且略偏位、染色質塊狀，胞質較一般淋巴球豐富且嗜鹼偏藍灰，外觀介於淋巴球與漿細胞之間，即漿細胞樣淋巴球（plasmacytoid lymphocyte）。
features: Small-to-intermediate lymphocyte, slightly larger than a mature small lymphocyte
Oval, slightly eccentric nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin
Moderate amount of basophilic, finely textured cytoplasm without a distinct perinuclear hof
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single lymphocyte with an oval, slightly eccentric nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin, no visible nucleolus, and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm. A well-developed perinuclear hof is not present. Findings are consistent with a plasmacytoid lymphocyte, a reactive variant seen in viral infections and immune responses; if numerous, lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma should be considered.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have a markedly eccentric nucleus, abundant deep blue cytoplasm, and a clear perinuclear hof.
Small lymphocytes have a central round nucleus with only a scant rim of cytoplasm.
Neoplastic plasmacytoid cells are numerous and clonal by flow cytometry with IgM paraprotein, which cannot be judged from a single cell.
